title: Alvida moula Hussain alvida moula Hussain
body:
Alvida moula. Hussain as alvida moula Hussain as
<<DIVIDER>>
Roke kehte hai yehi sab azaadare Hussain as
1.Hogaya maahe azaa karsake naa haq adaa
Girya o seena zani se abhi na Dil Bhara Phir se hoyegi bukaa (X 2)
Ghamzadoun ki hai sada .
<<MINI>>
Alvida moula Hussain as alvida moula Hussain as
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Seena e akber se jab tumne kahinchi thi sina
Haal e dil ho kya bayan tha nigahoun mein dhuwan
Is musibat ka teri (X 2) Phir se hoga tazkera .
<<MINI>>
Alvida moula Hussain as alvida moula Hussain as
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Halq par jis dum tere zulm ka khanjar chala
Khoon rulata hai humein wo tadapna aapka
Kushtaye joor o jafa (X 2)
Ay shaheed e karbala .
<<MINI>>
Alvida moula Hussain as alvida moula Hussain as
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Karbala ki dhoop mein saqiye kowsar ka laal
Haay asghar ke liye tera pani ka sawaal
Kis tarha bhulein bhala (X 2)
Teer aur nanha gala .
<<MINI>>
Alvida moula Hussain as alvida moula Hussain as
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Phir azakhanoun mein ab ek udasi chai hai
Aakhri purse ko ab fatima jo aayi hai
Kis zuban se hum kahein (X 2)
Alvida ay fatima .
<<MINI>>
Alvida moula Hussain as alvida moula Hussain as
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Shaahe dee’n ke khooon ka ab to lene inteqaam
Gaibat e kubra se ab aa bhi ja mere imam
Bas niyam e sabr mein (X 2)
Kab se hai khanjar Tera.
<<MINI>>
Alvida moula Hussain as alvida moula Hussain as
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Hai qamar ki ye dua ay binaye farshe gham
Aapke majaye ka dil se hoga gham na kam
Asghari ke matami (X 2)
Roke dete hain sada .
<<MINI>>
Alvida moula Hussain as alvida moula Hussain as
